variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are declared in VAR blocks. Type names are typically capitalized.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Strongly typed. Includes basic types, arrays, records, and pointers. Oberon introduced type extension (inheritance).

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Logical AND is '&', NOT is '~'. Equality is '='.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.code:
IF x > 0 THEN
  y := 1
ELSIF x < 0 THEN
  y := -1
ELSE
  y := 0
END;
conditionals.notes: Semicolons act as statement separators, not terminators, so they are not needed before ELSIF or ELSE.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: The FOR loop (removed in some minimalist versions of Oberon like Oberon-0, but present in standard Oberon/Oberon-2).

while_loop.title: While Loop

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Procedures can return values (acting as functions). Parameters can be passed by value or reference (VAR).

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Array size is specified before the OF keyword.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: No built-in map type. Must be implemented manually.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Relies on strong typing and runtime assertions rather than exception handling.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Oberon provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Oberon supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Oberon provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Oberon converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Oberon represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Oberon formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Oberon branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Oberon defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Oberon iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Oberon organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Oberon stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Oberon groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Oberon tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Oberon organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
